Bug_Title: RV: Random value from 0 to 1 is coerced to the integer 0 (RV_01_TO_INT)
Bug_Details:
A random value from 0 to 1 is being coerced to the integer value 0. You probably
want to multiply the random value by something else before coercing it to an integer, or use the Random.nextInt(n) method.
 Random.nextInt(n)
Bug_Explanation: The code generates a random double value between 0.0 and 1.0. By casting this double to an int, the fractional part is discarded, resulting in the integer value 0. This demonstrates the bug where a random value from 0 to 1 is coerced to the integer 0.
